In a transformation the pre-image is the original figure before the transformation and the image
of the transformation is the resulting figure after the transformation:
Translation is sliding a figure from one position to another
without turning or flipping the figure.
Rotation is turning a figure about a specific point.
Reflection is flipping a figure across a line of reflection to
Dilation is changing a figure's size by a certain scale factor.
